dict.string: HomeWalk can stream a live debug view of the walk to a Mac on this Wi-Fi network. Only when you turn it on.
HomeWalk uses your location once per walk to point the floor plan north and place it on your building outline. Optional; never in the background.
HomeWalk listens for the names of things you show so it can tick the prompt and pin what you said to the room. On-device when available.
